title: Bearau Lamar Commercial Tower
description:
Bearau Lamar Commercial Tower is a premier commercial complex by developer Lamar Development, presented by the agency Refine Development Management, located in Business Bay. The project includes six buildings with a ground floor and twelve to twenty-one levels.

Multiple sides of the property offer pristine waterfront views of the Dubai Canal.

Bearau Lamar Commercial Tower offers premium, large-scale office spaces. The project features ultra-luxury interiors in common areas and flexible office designs that owners can customize.

The project introduces a business and arts library, a cultural district with art exhibition spaces, a luxury cinema hall, and multiple performance areas.

Thanks to its strategic location, the complex provides quick access to key destinations, including The Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa - within 10 minutes, Jumeirah Beach - 17 minutes, and Dubai International Airport can be reached in 19 minutes.

For sale:

Retail - from 38 500 000 AED / 6 200 - 10 400 sq. ft.

Office - from 39 506 925 AED / 6 415 - 9 677 sq. ft.

EOI: 10%
